append.detail: CLOSED 2026-10-05: lib/listings-shared/listing-seo.ts prices a Free label as a $0 Offer, types a non-housing listing with no offer, rating or reviews as Thing instead of Product, and keeps the address on Accommodation only; spaceOfferingsSchema in lib/jsonld.ts emits an unpriced (contact) offering as a Service with a provider.
